🚌 Twin Cities Transit Map

Every bus, train and shuttle line that runs on the Go-To Student Unlimited pass — one map, one fare, no tap-hopping.

What's included

    How to use it

    • Search any city, address, station or route in the bar up top.
    • Tap anywhere on the map to see every stop and route near that spot.
    • Tap a stop for the routes that serve it, live arrivals, and nearby stops.
    • Tap a route for its full path, service days, and frequency.
    • 🔗 Share copies a link that reopens exactly this view.

    Live data

    Live bus positions and arrival counts come from Metro Transit's NextTrip API, so they cover Metro Transit routes only (MVTA, Maple Grove, Plymouth, SouthWest, U of M and Airport networks show scheduled service). Refresh ~20s.

    Data & source

    Unofficial project, not affiliated with Metro Transit or any agency. Schedules change — always confirm on metrotransit.org.
